ollama.title: Ollama Local API
ollama.en: Install Ollama on your computer, download a licensed local model and run ollama serve. Local API needs no key; cloud models use external services. Check RAM and English quality. Runs on your computer, not inside this app.
ollama.bg: Install Ollama on your computer, download a licensed local model and run ollama serve. Local API needs no key; cloud models use external services. Check RAM and English quality. Runs on your computer, not inside this app.

openai.title: OpenAI Responses API
openai.en: Create a project and billing account in OpenAI Platform. Install openai on your backend and set a server-side API key. Choose an available model explicitly. Never embed a key in an APK. Requests leave the device. Review current usage prices before deployment.
openai.bg: Create a project and billing account in OpenAI Platform. Install openai on your backend and set a server-side API key. Choose an available model explicitly. Never embed a key in an APK. Requests leave the device. Review current usage prices before deployment.

gemini.title: Gemini API
gemini.en: Obtain a key in Google AI Studio and use the official SDK on a backend. Check model availability, region, quotas and current prices. Requests go to the cloud; this app makes none.
gemini.bg: Obtain a key in Google AI Studio and use the official SDK on a backend. Check model availability, region, quotas and current prices. Requests go to the cloud; this app makes none.

sbert.title: Sentence Transformers
sbert.en: On your computer: pip install sentence-transformers. Download and pin a model revision; check its license, storage and English retrieval quality. Inference can run locally after download. Installation needs a Python environment.
sbert.bg: On your computer: pip install sentence-transformers. Download and pin a model revision; check its license, storage and English retrieval quality. Inference can run locally after download. Installation needs a Python environment.

sklearn.title: scikit-learn
sklearn.en: On your computer: pip install scikit-learn. TfidfVectorizer provides a local lexical baseline, not generative AI. Pin package versions and evaluate on a labelled set; vocabulary and training corpus affect results.
sklearn.bg: On your computer: pip install scikit-learn. TfidfVectorizer provides a local lexical baseline, not generative AI. Pin package versions and evaluate on a labelled set; vocabulary and training corpus affect results.

pydantic.title: Pydantic
pydantic.en: On your backend: pip install pydantic. Define required fields, ranges and enums, then validate before business actions. No API key needed. Schema validation does not verify factual claims.
pydantic.bg: On your backend: pip install pydantic. Define required fields, ranges and enums, then validate before business actions. No API key needed. Schema validation does not verify factual claims.

ocr.title: ML Kit Text Recognition Android
ocr.en: Use the official Android text-recognition dependency for the required script and pin its version. Bundled and downloaded models have different delivery requirements. Verify the supported-language list; the Latin package does not establish additional-language Cyrillic support. No OCR engine is bundled here.
ocr.bg: Use the official Android text-recognition dependency for the required script and pin its version. Bundled and downloaded models have different delivery requirements. Verify the supported-language list; the Latin package does not establish additional-language Cyrillic support. No OCR engine is bundled here.

litert.title: LiteRT-LM
litert.en: Follow the repository Android/Kotlin setup on a separate development project. Choose a compatible licensed model. Check RAM, download size, runtime support and English on a real device. This app contains no model runtime.
litert.bg: Follow the repository Android/Kotlin setup on a separate development project. Choose a compatible licensed model. Check RAM, download size, runtime support and English on a real device. This app contains no model runtime.

mlkit.title: ML Kit GenAI
mlkit.en: Check each GenAI API for supported devices, languages, Android version and AICore requirements. Follow the official Android integration instructions. Availability is device-specific; there is no universal on-device model in this app.
mlkit.bg: Check each GenAI API for supported devices, languages, Android version and AICore requirements. Follow the official Android integration instructions. Availability is device-specific; there is no universal on-device model in this app.
